description: This JavaScript source file defines a client for interacting with a backend API, providing functions to build URLs, handle query parameters, perform HTTP GET and JSON requests using fetch, and expose a minimal axios-like API. It includes helper functions for URL construction, parameter sanitization, request parsing, and specific API endpoints such as listing users, sessions, deployments, costs, and obtaining health status.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Detects whether a given URL string is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: buildUrl(pathOrUrl)
methods.description: Constructs a complete URL by combining a base and relative path or returning absolute URLs as-is. Handles relative paths, '/api' paths, and absolute URLs.

methods.name: toQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Builds a query string from an object of parameters, handling arrays and nested objects.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot(pathOrUrl)
methods.description: Checks if a URL path is the root of the session-tracking API endpoint.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams(pathOrUrl, params = {})
methods.description: Sanitizes and filters query parameters based on specific API endpoint rules to prevent unsupported or insecure queries.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams(pathOrUrl, params = {})
methods.description: Ensures query parameters include necessary scope-specific identifiers like organization_id or tenant_id based on endpoint rules.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams(pathOrUrl, effParams)
methods.description: Builds a URL by appending a query string, merging with existing query string parameters if present.

methods.name: parseResponse(res)
methods.description: Parses an HTTP response, returning an object with 'ok', 'status', and 'payload' (JSON or text).

methods.name: httpGet(pathOrUrl, { params, headers, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request with scoping and parameter handling, returning the response data or throwing an error on failure.

methods.name: httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal, params } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP JSON request (POST, PUT, DELETE) with appropriate headers, URL, and body, handling response parsing.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload(payload)
methods.description: Normalizes payloads from list API responses, extracting items, total count, and meta information.

methods.name: getApiClient()
methods.description: Provides a minimal API client with methods: get, post, put, delete, using fetch.

methods.name: health()
methods.description: Checks backend health status by requesting root or fallback health endpoint.

methods.name: listUsers(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of users from the API, normalizing the response and ignoring extraneous params.

methods.name: listSessions(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches session tracking records, enforcing tenant scope, and normalizes the response.

methods.name: listDeployments(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches app deployment records and normalizes them.

methods.name: listLlmCosts(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches LLM cost records and normalizes the response.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummaryStrict()
methods.description: Fetches the tenant users summary with only organization_id as an explicit query parameter.

ctags.name: httpJson
ctags.pattern: /^async function httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal, params } = {}) {$/
